definitions: Engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than for serious or practical purpose.
Take part in a game or sport.
Operate (a device) to produce sound or vision.
Perform (a role) in a theatrical performance or film.
Move lightly and quickly, or to flicker.
Deal with (a situation) in a particular way.
examples: The children play in the garden.
He played the part of Hamlet.
A smile played on her lips.
